name: rasmuse/eust
what_it_holds: Tools to download, ARCHIVE, and read Eurostat data (2 stars, MIT). The archiving angle matters: it snapshots dataset pulls rather than always hitting the live (revised) series.
why_useful: Archiving a Eurostat pull is exactly the point-in-time / vintage capability called out as HIGH-value (gap #4) — Eurostat series like tour_occ get revised, and this tool is built to keep dated snapshots rather than only current values.

name: imkejoor/airPaDE
what_it_holds: Code package (3 stars, MIT, updated 2026-03-10) that downloads and extracts Eurostat data parameters used in causal air-passenger-demand estimation, plus implementations of several air-passenger-volume estimation approaches between city pairs.
why_useful: Directly touches gap #10 (airline capacity/traffic) using Eurostat inputs — a ready-made air-passenger demand estimation toolkit for European city pairs, useful as an EU travel-volume proxy alongside tour_occ.
time_coverage: as published Eurostat air transport series
themes: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE
why_all: Directly touches gap #10 (airline capacity/traffic) using Eurostat inputs — a ready-made air-passenger demand estimation toolkit for European city pairs, useful as an EU travel-volume proxy alongside tour_occ.

name: flame175kk-collab/frontur-estacionalidad-turismo
what_it_holds: Spanish-language repo analysing seasonality of Spanish tourism by country of origin and region (CCAA) using official INE Frontur/Egatur data pulled with Python; identifies which origin markets could fill off-season hotel demand. Updated 2026-08-28.
why_useful: A working Python pipeline against INE Frontur/Egatur (Spain inbound/outbound tourist arrivals and spend) broken out by CCAA and origin country — finer-grained than the INE Frontur/EOH series we already hold, and could be adapted to pull EOAT tourist-apartment tables from the same INE portal.
geography: Spain, by CCAA and country of origin
time_coverage: recent (as of repo date, likely multi-year Frontur/Egatur history)
duplicate_of_holding: We hold INE Spain Frontur/EOH at national level; this is a CCAA/origin-country-level pipeline, finer-grained
themes: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE
why_all: A working Python pipeline against INE Frontur/Egatur (Spain inbound/outbound tourist arrivals and spend) broken out by CCAA and origin country — finer-grained than the INE Frontur/EOH series we already hold, and could be adapted to pull EOAT tourist-apartment tables from the same INE portal.

name: pipeworx-io/mcp-destatis
what_it_holds: MCP server (4 commits, MIT) exposing Destatis GENESIS-Online search and table retrieval (population, GDP, CPI, employment, foreign trade, production) to AI agents; part of a larger 'Pipeworx' 1476-source gateway.
why_useful: A live, current tool to query Destatis GENESIS for German hotel/accommodation nights and occupancy tables (Germany is a top-5 ABNB EU market); complements Eurostat tour_occ with a national-source route that may have finer NUTS/city detail and faster releases.
themes: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE

Generic GENESIS-Online access point; would need testing whether it can reach German tourism/accommodation tables (45412-series) — not confirmed from README. Low confidence, early-stage repo.

name: eurostat/restatapi
what_it_holds: Official Eurostat R package (35 stars) to search and retrieve ANY Eurostat SDMX dataset, not just tour_ce_omr platform nights — includes accommodation capacity, occupancy rate by NUTS2 region, nights spent by country of residence, and tourism-industry employment tables.
why_useful: Alternate official SDMX route into tour_occ/tour_ce tables with finer partial-download control (useful for pulling only e.g. NUTS2 accommodation-nights subsets without downloading whole bulk files).
